problem: Inner-train inference on checkpoint training identities is TRAIN_RESUBSTITUTION_CALIBRATION — NOT independent. Cannot produce authoritative calibrators or threshold selection.

three_identity_sets.calibrator_fit_identities: Identities used to fit RAW/INTERCEPT/PLATT parameters per head
three_identity_sets.policy_selection_identities: Identities used to select grasp/manipulation/release-veto thresholds
three_identity_sets.heldout_evaluation_identities: Identities used for final L3 evaluation metrics

A_nested_group_holdout.description: Within each inner-train fold, further split identities into calibrator-fit and policy-selection groups. Heldout = original inner-val.

B_group_cross_fit_OOF.description: Use checkpoint A to predict checkpoint B's inner-train identities (cross-fold OOF logits). Fit calibrator on A's OOF predictions of B's identities.

C_independent_calibration_identities.description: Pre-register identities never used in any checkpoint training. Generate their logits as independent calibration data.

D_project_frozen_equivalent.description: Alternative no-leakage design frozen by project protocol.

current_state.available_data: inner-train inference on checkpoint training identities
current_state.recommended_action: Select one of schemes A/B/C/D, freeze in protocol, generate corresponding artifacts

threshold_selection.requires: independent policy-selection identities (disjoint from both calibrator-fit and heldout)
